what: Dark-music firmware for the FM-1: 21 genres and 210 pieces, from dark techno to dark ambient and darkwave, and more. Pick a piece and it plays, and Wander can slowly evolve it on its own. Play live with the arp (with Hold) and Dice, or write patterns in the step editor, even while the arp runs. New in 1.0.5: brand new visuals, simplified settings, bigger and easier-to-read text, plain-language help, and a SEL shortcut menu.
author: Polystellarflow
